content: Keep a finger under the bed mount to keep the M3nN nut from falling out as you start the M3x18 screws. It helped to clear the screw holes in the spacer before trying to screw them in or you have to twist the screw thru the spacer and the nut vice just the nut.
The M3nN nuts mentioned in this step are already in place. These are NOT the nuts that were prepared in step 6. Those two M3nN nuts will be used later.
When and where should I have inserted the M3nN nuts?
